overview_reconciliation.summary: General HTML/body authoring guide, not an endpoint: description_html is sanitized, converted to editor format and replaces the entire page body on update. Standard HTML, safe URL protocols and entity-backed editor components are payload shapes on existing page create/update operations. The attachment recipe reuses workspace asset credentials with entity_type PAGE_DESCRIPTION, storage upload_data.url, existing page confirmation, then a full body write containing attachment-component with the returned asset ID. There is explicitly no multipart page-attachment endpoint. Visibility and unlocked/active edit requirements qualify existing attachment operations, not new routes.
overview_reconciliation.capture_policy: Existing capture digests, byte counts and digest representation preserved; this review adds independently authored reconciliation, not a replacement capture.
